enrichment_policy: Endpoint currencies are enriched as distinct three-mode dynamics before testing: QM-side modes are density, phase-order, and transport; GR-side modes are density, transport, and curvature-scale.

shadow_maps.S_QM: projection of u to neutral-density, phase-order, transport
shadow_maps.S_GR: projection of u to neutral-density, transport, curvature-scale

controls.placeholder: zero currency predicts zero endpoint shadows
controls.union_direct_sum: direct sum of the two endpoint currencies; recovers but has no compression
controls.collapse_typed_seed: one scalar seed with equal shadows; fails recovery and distinctness
